import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { Router } from '@angular/router'; import { OrderService } from 'src/app/services/order.service'; import { Order } from 'src/app/models/order.model'; @Component({ selector: 'app-my-orders', templateUrl: './my-orders.component.html', styleUrls: ['./my-orders.component.css'], }) export class MyOrdersComponent implements OnInit { orders: Order[] = []; isLoading = true; selectedOrder: Order | null = null; showTrackModal = false; constructor( private orderService: OrderService, private router: Router, ) {} ngOnInit(): void { this.loadOrders(); } loadOrders(): void { const buyerName = localStorage.getItem('username'); if (!buyerName) { alert('Please login to view your orders'); this.router.navigate(['/login']); return; } this.isLoading = true; this.orderService.getUserOrders(buyerName).subscribe({ next: (data) => { this.orders = data; this.isLoading = false; }, error: (err) => { console.error('Error loading orders:', err); this.isLoading = false; alert('Failed to load orders'); }, }); } getStatusClass(delivered: boolean): string { return delivered ? 'status-delivered' : 'status-pending'; } getStatusText(delivered: boolean): string { return delivered ? 'Delivered' : 'Pending'; } getImageUrl(imageName: string): string { return 'http://localhost:8080/api/user/items/images/' + imageName; } onImageError(event: any): void { event.target.src = 'https://via.placeholder.com/80x80/667eea/ffffff?text=Product'; } trackOrder(order: Order): void { this.selectedOrder = order; this.showTrackModal = true; } closeTrackModal(): void { this.showTrackModal = false; this.selectedOrder = null; } reorder(order: Order): void { this.router.navigate(['/user/items']); } writeReview(order: Order): void { this.router.navigate(['/user/feedback']); } goToShop(): void { this.router.navigate(['/user/items']); } getEstimatedDelivery(): Date { const date = new Date(); date.setDate(date.getDate() + 5); return date; } }
